# Niltavi UI

Install the Niltavi UI Skill in the current project with:

```sh
npx skills add niltavi/niltavi-ui --skill niltavi-ui
```

Check the agent's project skills directory for `niltavi-ui/SKILL.md`. Reload skills and invoke `$niltavi-ui` in Codex or `/niltavi-ui` in Claude Code.

- [For Agents](https://github.com/niltavi/niltavi-ui/blob/main/docs/en/for-agents.md)
- [Favicon and app icon specification](https://github.com/niltavi/niltavi-ui/blob/main/skills/niltavi-ui/references/favicon.md)
- [Shared product header and theme](https://github.com/niltavi/niltavi-ui/tree/main/src/product)
- [Live examples](https://ui.niltavi.com/#/components)
